addictionPotential: 中度成瘾且滥用潜力高。
summary: 一种相当罕见的共情剂，与 MDMA 关系密切，但效力更弱。
effectsSummary: MDEA is an entactogen similar to MDMA but milder. Increased empathy, mild euphoria, enhanced sensory perception. Less stimulating than MDMA.
dosageRemark: MDEA is less potent than MDMA. Effects are milder but also less stimulating.
generalRisks: Hyperthermia, serotonin syndrome. Jaw clenching, increased heart rate. Similar risks to MDMA but generally milder.
longtermRisks: Regular use may cause neurotoxicity and serotonin system damage.
saferUse: 避免与其他血清素药物同用。
